official_chargers.name: State-wise public EV charging stations (Ministry of Power inputs, PIB annexure)
official_chargers.cleaning: Parsed from PDF; state names normalised; row total checked against printed total (29,277).
official_chargers.limitations: Counts stations, not connectors. Telangana/Andhra split as reported.

osm_chargers.name: OpenStreetMap charging stations (amenity=charging_station)
osm_chargers.cleaning: Nodes/ways/relations reduced to a point (way centre); kept operator, sockets, capacity, power tags.
osm_chargers.limitations: Volunteer-mapped; coverage varies by city. Many operator stations are not yet in OSM.

official_ev_state.name: State-wise registered EVs as on 03-08-2023 (VAHAN, Lok Sabha reply via PIB)
official_ev_state.cleaning: Parsed from press-release HTML; names normalised; total checked (28,30,565).
official_ev_state.limitations: Telangana and Lakshadweep not reported (Telangana not on central VAHAN then).

official_national.name: National EV stock & charger totals (Lok Sabha USQ 1956 & 453, July 2026)
official_national.limitations: BHEL-portal charger total has no state split; we scale the 2025 state split to it.

annual_registrations.name: Year-wise EV registrations 2018-2025
annual_registrations.limitations: 2023-25 are rounded figures from secondary reports of VAHAN, not the dashboard itself.

ocm.name: Open Charge Map India (open export, github.com/openchargemap/ocm-export)
ocm.cleaning: Dropped not-operational / planned / removed POIs; merged with OSM when within 50 m and a similar name (2,267 unique stations).
ocm.limitations: Crowd-sourced; some entries are old. Private operator apps are not included (no open licence).

vahan_manual.name: VAHAN dashboard manual exports (state x vehicle class x year, fuel = Electric)
vahan_manual.limitations: Manual export; automate via the dashboard's report API in the roadmap.

boundaries.name: District & state boundaries (Census 2011 districts, DataMeet)
boundaries.cleaning: Telangana districts split from Andhra Pradesh; Leh & Kargil moved to Ladakh; states dissolved from districts; geometry simplified (states ~1 km, districts ~500 m).
boundaries.limitations: 2011 district map (640 districts). India now has ~780 districts; new districts sit inside their parent 2011 district.

census.name: Census of India 2011 district tables (population, households, urban households, vehicle ownership)
census.cleaning: Joined on census district code; urban share = urban households / households.
census.limitations: 2026 population = 2011 x 1.206 (UN WPP national growth) for every district -> marked Estimated.

worldpop.name: WorldPop 2020 population grid, 1 km, UN-adjusted (India)
worldpop.cleaning: Cells assigned to districts by rasterising boundaries; rescaled to each district's 2026 population.

merge_chargers.name: Merged real charger points (OSM + OCM, de-duplicated)
merge_chargers.cleaning: OSM 608; OCM duplicates merged 0; OCM new 0. Rule: <=50 m apart and same/unknown operator or name similarity > 0.5 -> one charger with both sources listed. Dropped 2 points outside India's district boundaries (offshore / across the border).
merge_chargers.limitations: Mapped points cover only part of the official total; see completeness per state.

modelled_chargers.name: Modelled charger locations (to reach official totals)
modelled_chargers.cleaning: Per district: derived official total minus mapped real points; positions sampled from WorldPop cells with probability ~ population^1.5 (seed 42); DC share 31.4% from Lok Sabha USQ 453.
modelled_chargers.limitations: Positions are statistical placeholders, not real stations. Used only so distance/coverage metrics reflect the official charger count; switch them off on the map to see mapped points only.

forecast.name: EV stock forecast (CAGR & logistic fits; Low/Base/High scenarios)
forecast.cleaning: Stock series back-calculated from the official 26-Jul-2026 stock minus annual registrations (Jan-Jul 2026 estimated at 1,542,917).
forecast.limitations: State forecasts assume each state keeps its current share of national EV stock.

osm_highways.name: OpenStreetMap national highways (ref NH*/NE*)
osm_highways.cleaning: Ways merged per NH ref, simplified (~200 m tolerance); one-way carriageways count half (dual carriageways are mapped twice).
osm_highways.limitations: Some NH segments lack a ref tag in OSM; length is an underestimate of the official ~1.46 lakh km.

osm_substations.name: OpenStreetMap power substations (power=substation)
osm_substations.cleaning: Reduced to points; voltage kept where tagged.
osm_substations.limitations: Proxy for grid readiness only; no DISCOM spare-capacity data.

osm_pois.name: OpenStreetMap candidate sites (fuel stations, malls, tourist attractions, logistics areas)
osm_pois.cleaning: Reduced to points with a category.
